quote: The driver of a vehicle about to enter or cross a highway from a private way shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on such highway.

activation.condition: Driver of a vehicle is about to enter or cross a highway from a private way, with vehicles approaching on that highway.

obligation.description: Yield right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on the highway.

timing.description: Measure original private-way approach, highway entry, all approaching vehicle arrivals and continuous roadway occupancy.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on such highway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Every approaching vehicle must be inventoried; conflict order, occupancy and speed response are observations, not legal thresholds.

parameter_refs.name: private_way_geometry
range_or_domain: private way terminates at two-way paved highway
